title: I am giving Google Pro AI gift if you call games not "AI Slop"
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
Hi everyone, there are too many toxic people just downvoting without reason in this AI ganes channel.

I'm looking for someone here who thinks like me. I think there are a few kids, around 12 or 13 years old, who are against AI, and that's why when I ask them why they're here, they can't offer any explanation.

I am looking someone visioner and using AI for making great games as a tool.

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body: There are people who call games “AI slop” but if you think that it’s just 12 year or 13 year old kids, you’re mistaken. People are doing this for understandable reasons and there are adults doing it.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body:
Why don't we call people slop for what it is? 

If you have kids. Tell them I said their artwork is shit and they should stop trying or get good.

replies.author: waxenpi
replies.body: You should ask AI if this is a good analogy.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: I'll feed it your content.

replies.author: waxenpi
replies.body: I’ve made notable art for some big brands so surely it’s already eaten it. Regardless, your analogy is lacking meaning.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body:
Its about people being early in on new tech and  have the courage to put their work out there even if it's not ready.  You dont have to consume it or like it, or how's this, say anything at all, if you can't be a good steward. 

Sorry you find that difficult to track or just obtuse to any other perspective.

replies.author: waxenpi
replies.body: What does any of that have to do with a child making art?

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body:
Oh bless your heart, you should have told me I was wasting my time. 

You haven't done anything you claimed to.

replies.author: waxenpi
replies.body: You must be responding to the wrong comment. Irrelevant response to a simple question. A child can use AI to make art and they can make art themselves. So can an adult. There is no correlation between an adult making art with AI and a child making art with their imagination. Hope this helps clear up an already simple concept!

replies.body:

Plus i don't need you to tell my kids they're doing crappy drawing. I'm working in artistic domain for 20 years so, i tell to them that what they do is my favorite crappy piece of art and  in encourage them to try to improve if they want to.

replies.body: You're proving my point.  You can do that on reddit too.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body:
If you are over 18, have zero game development experience, and are falling for this propaganda, I'm sorry, but the government is fooling you..  
  
They've simply fallen for American and British propaganda. Wait and see.

Most of AI games will defeat current AAA's asset quality in next 2-3 years.

replies.author: theflossboss1
replies.body: Ok

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body: Sorry, this comment isn’t coherent or clear.

replies.author: [deleted]
replies.body: [removed]

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body: Really?

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body:
This is a false argument.  "Slop" has always been there and is usually a result of someone's ambition outrunning their skill level. Which I'm perfectly fine with.

Go to any art or steam feed and see 90% of the stuff that just isn't ready for commercial release. 


Calling anything slop is wrong. Period.  It short circuits development and erodes the community.  I'm not saying you should pretend it's great, I'm saying be constructive in your comments.

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body:
It sounds like you misunderstood what I’m saying. 

What I’m saying is that it’s understandable why people call things “AI slop”. It’s not just children, but adults who understand what they’re doing. You can disagree with them, you can think it’s wrong, but you can’t make the case that they’re just children.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: I never said it's children, but ii don't think it's relevant.  AI natives will run the world in 10 years.  So let them learn, make mistakes and continually improve.

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body:
It was OP who said it was children, and that’s what I’m replying to. 

It’s normal to make mistakes and improve. One of the mistakes that you can make is thinking that the people criticizing you are children or stupid, or that they don’t have understandable reasons for their behavior. OP made this mistake. Note that “understandable” is not the same as “excusable”.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: Oh yeah. I'm agreeing with you.

replies.author: EasterElk
replies.body: Bad games have always been around. Slop hasn't. "Slop" isn't just a euphemism for bad. If you don't understand the criticism, of course it's going to see inaccurate to you.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body:
You're just arguing semantics.  Just because you don't call asset flips "slop" or other apparently "low effort" things, doesn't mean it's not all in the same category of low effort shovelware.

My point is, who are you helping by tagging things as slop?  

Its like saying the dog shit on the floor, there is no particular skill or value in it, almost as if it's a type of "slop" on its own.

replies.author: EasterElk
replies.body:
>My point is, who are you helping by tagging things as slop?

People who don't want to purchase slop?

And I don't really understand your analogy. Sometimes it is precisely correct to say that there's shit on the floor. Especially when it's not their floor and not their shit. 

When this happens, it's much weirder to pretend there isn't shit, or to pretend that it doesn't smell. Getting irritated at the people who are pointing out there's shit on your floor is your prerogative, but it won't make the shit go away.

AI slop is not the same as shovelware, even if there is plenty of overlap. It's not slop just because it's bad or just because it's AI. It's slop because it's bad *in a way that is unique to generative AI*. If you make something that isn't slop, and you use AI, that's cool. Literally every major game studio is using AI right now. Every single one. But they aren't all making slop.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: What I'm saying is, it's already readily apparent.  You're doing nothing.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: You're arguing against points nobody made.  Stop with this slop already.

replies.author: EasterElk
replies.body: It's literally the topic of the top-level comment we're both replying to, and a direct response to your earlier question. You're not obligated to participate if you don't want to, though.

replies.author: Warrmak
replies.body: You're responding with points nobody made, and definitions you yourself made up. Nobody said ignore AI slop. My point was, it's obvious, therefore brigading it is low value, low effort slop.

comments.author: riccioverde11
comments.body:
Dude on this sub there are 95/100 games being slop, they just suck and that's it. 

Learn to make games with ai, or stop busting our balls with low quality content.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body:
First, I’m saying that I created what I believe to be the first truly **agentic game** of its kind. Making a PC game is much harder than it may look from the outside, especially before AI-assisted development became available.

Being anti-AI is completely pointless.

Second, I think there is a misunderstanding about how games were traditionally made. Before AI, even a relatively small game required programming, 3D modeling, animation, technical art, sound, level design which is Kebabstar is made by me and a huge amount of manual work.   
  
I started Kebabstar  with DALL·E and gradually built the game using AI-assisted workflows since 2022-..... Without these tools, creating this particular game as a very small team would have been extremely difficult, if not realistically possible within our resources.

You are completely free to dislike the visual style or the concept. But dismissing it simply as “AI slop” overlooks the actual development process and what is technically being demonstrated here.

I am %99 sure you do not have any knowledge about understanding technical status of games.

replies.body:
Dude I'm a game dev. No need for the pitch sale. 
Making games as become as easier than ever, but so is also the slop. Stop slipping and life is gonna be fine.

replies.body: Can't believe you are getting brigaded on this sub.

replies.body: Why stop though?  How else is someone going to learn if not for the crucible of public feedback?

replies.body: Where did you come up with this  theory?

replies.body: You only need to spend five minutes looking at the endless AI-generated garbage on YouTube to realize that "slop" isn't propaganda. It's a firehose of homogeneous, low-quality content that generative AI has lowered the bar for creating. It's not slop because it's AI. It's slop because it's bad, and in a way that is unique to AI.

I'm making a game with AI and have received no hate. No one has claimed my game was made with AI. The capsule art is AI and no one has mentioned it. No comments about the AI disclosure.

replies.author: leveragedin
replies.body: Yeah it happens to everyone. Just try to distinguish the hate from feedback. Any feedback is better than none and presents an opportunity to reflect.

comments.author: EasterElk
comments.body:
>I think there are a few kids, around 12 or 13 years old, who are against AI

It's not slop because it's AI. It's slop because it's *shitty*, and in a way that is unique to AI. There have always been lots of bad games. But now there are endless *slop* games, and it's not the same thing. Don't blame your frustration on 12- or 13-year-olds. Blame the people who keep posting garbage.
